title: Handwrite I'm not a robot
description: Write the phrase yourself. We barely check spelling. We obsessively check whether your strokes move like a living hand.

concept.action: Handwrite "I'm not a robot" with a mouse, finger or stylus.
concept.sequence: Write, submit, watch your strokes replay colour-coded by speed, then read a forensic report on your hand.
concept.difficulty: Writing legibly with a mouse is hard, and every careful, smooth, steady line you draw to make it neater looks more like a machine.
concept.success: The scrawl loosely resembles the phrase and the strokes pass the kinematics tests: speed variation, two-thirds power law, timing, tremor, real input.
